runtimeMapping.ordinary: One ground/aerial retained target; .4 event with capped playback, speed15 outward, .01s dwell, speed3.75 return. Next attack requires cooldown and the held projectile gate.
runtimeMapping.s1: Selected ATK scale; first target plus selected number of bounces, radius1.7, speed6 on later segments. Fresh non-current targets preferred using .7s memory; repeat fallback resets memory when no fresh target is available. Single-victim case does not bounce to itself. Removed target uses its last point for later selection. Native reset/selection dispatch and exact body collider overlap remain unverified.
runtimeMapping.s2: Manual25s ATK modifier; selected idle/loop clips. One initial hit plus four current-ATK cuts at .25/.5/.75/1s; selected one-second Sluggish through the shared status pipeline and refusal hooks. Target invalidity ends cuts and returns early. Cuts and flight remain independent after skill expiry/source withdrawal.
runtimeMapping.return: Local return speed uses serialized base15 times comebackScale.25, including S1 after speed6 bounce segments. Native mover phase arithmetic, total-flight lifespan boundaries and subframe return/damage/buff order remain unverified.
runtimeMapping.counter: Opt-in HP outputDamage hook runs after source attribution but before recipient prevention, modifier/dodge/receipt hooks. Elemental buildup uses its separate pipeline. Exactly twenty attributable outputs per deployment add selected permanent Physical dodge; no Arts dodge or stacks.
runtimeMapping.sp: Source attack recovery preserved; extra cuts do not issue extra attacks. S1 returns its charge if the retained target dies before release; local next-attack skill end resumes SP at emission. Native full-animation cast-end timing is unverified.

verificationLimits: Compiled native bounce target order, hit-memory reset callback, speed-after-reach/comeback phase arithmetic, current victim removal and lifespan boundaries were not recovered as executable code. The bounded local mover is explicitly recorded rather than asserted frame identical.
Point-centre radius1.7 selection is not exact native CircleCollider2D/body intersection. Straight planar projectiles substitute for native curves, trails, particles and audio.
S2 quarter-second cuts run before the one-second return in the local scheduling order. Native buff-expiry/trigger/damage/withdraw callback order is unverified.

S2 active attachment serializes isDamageMissable0 while its DB-loaded Sluggish template serializes isDamageMissable1. Native load/override precedence was not recovered; the local slow attachment precedes damage without a separate miss roll.

Output counter before recipient prevention is a local mapping of native ON_OUTPUT_DAMAGE and authored attachment notes. Native C# event dispatch and elemental-injury attachment parity are not certified.
S2 original mode switch/restart is immediate, with recovered Idle/Loop clips; no unbound Begin/End dispatch is invented. Native skill/state startup and exact frame parity are unverified.
All20 source ranks, promotion/potential tiers and two original delivered skeleton chains are retained. Modules, original native effects/audio and full game fidelity remain unfinished.

facts: Talent counter is a damage attachment processed before damage. All attributable damage can count, not only ordinary attack HP receipts.
Loopshooters must recover every thrown projectile before their next attack; the displayed attack interval is a minimum, not a guaranteed cycle.

recoveredFacts: Native ordinary and S2 tracked movers use speed15, comeback1, comebackSpeedScale.25 and source-managed0/source-invalid-stop0. Ordinary return dwell is .009999999776s; S2 latch delay1s and target ALL-motion validation are serialized.

S1 bounce mover contains radius1.7000000477, speed15 then speedAfterFirstReach6, keepAlreadyHitTime.6999999881, lifetime25, bounceTimesAsDamageTimes0, allowRepetitionIfNoTarget1, fixAllowRepetitionIfNoTarget1, hitTraceTargetIfNoOtherTarget0, useMapPosIfTargetInvalid1.

S2 selected atk .05.. .5 applies as ATK percent for25s. Attack-prefix interval.25,cutDuration1,sluggish1,projectileDelay1 andcutScale1 are present in every rank. The cut template verifies ALL-motion enemy each trigger, applies NORMAL Physical RANGED current-ATK damage, and finishes on invalidity. The source description specifies four additional cuts.

Evade trigger increments output damage count, requires exactly selected threshold20, creates the permanent Physical-only Evade buff and finishes its checker. Talent probabilities at E1 .15/P5 .18,E2 .35/P5 .38; E0 has no unlocked checker.

Literal Attack and S1 events .4, S2Loop .333, default/S1 maxAnimScale1; explicit Down animation overrides are retained. S2 mode init replaces Idle with selected Skill2Idle. Begin/End clips exist but no animation-controller binding to them was recovered.
